gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The statement of purpose should name UW faculty you'd like to work with; no rule on securing an advisor before admission is stated.

funding.value: Admitted students are given RA, TA or fellowship support, subject to available funds and satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: Students admitted to the graduate program are provided financial support in the form of research assistantships, teaching assistantships, and fellowships.

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's in engineering or a science such as biology, chemistry or physics.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should have a bachelor’s degree in engineering (biomedical, chemical, electrical, industrial, mechanical, etc.) or science (biology, biochemistry, chemistry, genetics, immunology, physics, etc.).

fee_waiver.value: The fee cannot be waived by the department; only Graduate School fee grants (domestic only) apply.
fee_waiver.quote: This fee cannot be waived or deferred. Fee grants are available through the Graduate School under certain conditions.

notes: All BME PhD students teach; those who needed an English test must take the SPEAK test in their first semester. Department site (engineering.wisc.edu) blocked.
